User_Story_Description: As a mobile buyer I want real-time AI autocomplete suggestions so I can find KDP coffee pods faster
As a search PM I want zero-result fallback recommendations so users see related items instead of blank pages
As a product analyst I want rank_position passed in JSON clickstream payloads to track SERP rank CTR
As an engineer I want automated Chi-Square SRM checks running daily to detect telemetry tracking bugs
As a mobile buyer I want filter facets for roast level and brand so I can refine 20+ search results
